snippet.title: Reapercussions - Game Trailer for a new Balatro-like indie game!
snippet.description:
Reapercussions is an upcoming indie game where you play as a Reaper collecting souls for Purgatory using the fabled death dice. Here's the teaser trailer for the upcoming game. 

Coming early 2027, demo coming in November. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5383750/Reapercussions/

Check out illi.gg for more info. 

#Reapercussions #balatro #IndieGame #GodotEngine #SteamNextFest
